description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Appointed Mr. S. Virithamulla as the Arbitrator for the Settlement of the Industrial Dispute between Mr. M. A. Ranasinghe and Sri Lankan Airlines Limited (S, E Only)
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters. It contains an order made under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, appointing an arbitrator to settle an industrial dispute between an individual and a company. The content focuses on the application of existing legislation, the appointment of a legal authority (arbitrator), and the referral of a dispute for arbitration - all of which fall under legal framework and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
